submissionSource: async(item,label,expectedStatus='0x1',trace=false)=>{const t=item.transaction??item; const envelope={from:t.from,to:t.to,data:t.input??t.data,value:t.value??'0x0',gas:bound,gasPrice:'0x77359400'}; const timestamp=item.receipt?.blockTimestamp; if(timestamp!==undefined)await rpc('evm_setNextBlockTimestamp',[Number(timestamp)]); let simulation;try{simulation={ok:true,result:await rpc('eth_call',[envelope,'pending'])};}catch(error){simulation={ok:false,error:String(error)};} const hash=await rpc('eth_sendTransaction',[envelope]);await rpc('evm_mine'); const receipt=await rpc('eth_getTransactionReceipt',[hash]);const transaction=await rpc('eth_getTransactionByHash',[hash]);const block=await rpc('eth_getBlockByNumber',[receipt.blockNumber,false]); const result={label,simulation,transaction,receipt,canonical:block.hash===receipt.blockHash};ownedTransactions.push(result);if(trace)result.trace=await rpc('debug_traceTransaction',[hash,{tracer:'callTracer'}]);if(!result.canonical||receipt.status!==expectedStatus||transaction.gas!==bound)throw new Error('Receipt gate '+JSON.stringify({label,hash,status:receipt.status,gas:transaction.gas}));return result;}

canonicalContents=(await query(registry,vaultQueryABI,'calcContentsId',[Array.from(config.tokens)]))[0];const tokenQueries=[['vaultsOfTokens',[Array.from(config.tokens)]],['vaultsOfPkgOfTokens',[pkg,Array.from(config.tokens)]]];for(const type of config.vaultTypes)tokenQueries.push(['vaultsOfTypeOfTokens',[type,Array.from(config.tokens)]]);r.tokenArrayQueries=[];for(const[name,params]of tokenQueries){const values=(await matched=contains(values,address);r.tokenArrayQueries.push({name,args:params,values:Array.from(values),matched});if(!matched){ensure(canonicalContents!==config.contentsId,'Missing canonical query(source,packageABI,'facetCuts'))[0])for(const sel of cut.functionSelectors){if(cut.action===2n)expected.delete(sel);else expected.set(sel,cut.facetAddress.toLowerCase());}for(const type of(await facet.functionSelectors){ensure(expected.get(sel)===facet.facetAddress.toLowerCase(),'Incorrect ordered routing '+sel);actualCount++;}ensure(actualCount===expected.size,'Extra/missing runtimeBindingSource: async(address,name,file=name+'.sol')=>{const key=address.toLowerCase()+':'+name;if(completeBindingKeys.has(key))return;const artifact=JSON.parse(await read(wt+'/out/'+file+'/'+name+'.json'));const code=await rpc('eth_getCode',[address,'latest']);let actual=code.slice(2),expected=artifact.deployedBytecode.object.slice(2);const links=[],immutables=[];for(const[id,ranges]of Object.entries(artifact.deployedBytecode.immutableReferences??{})){for(const{start,length}of ranges){immutables.push({id,start,length,value:'0x'+actual.slice(start*2,(start+length)*2)});actual=actual.slice(0,start*2)+'0'.repeat(length*2)+actual.slice((start+length)*2);}}for(const[source,names]of Object.entries(artifact.deployedBytecode.linkReferences??{})){for(const[library,ranges]of Object.entries(names)){let linked;for(const{start,length}of ranges){const value='0x'+code.slice(2+start*2,2+(start+length)*2);if(linked)ensure(value===linked,'Inconsistent library link');linked=value;actual=actual.slice(0,start*2)+'0'.repeat(length*2)+actual.slice((start+length)*2);expected=expected.slice(0,start*2)+'0'.repeat(length*2)+expected.slice((start+length)*2);}links.push({source,library,address:linked,ranges});await bindCurrentRuntime(linked,library,source.split('/').at(-1));}}ensure(actual===expected,'Normalized runtime mismatch '+name);allRuntimeBindings.push({address,name,file,runtimeHash:ethers.keccak256(code),runtime:code,artifactRuntimeObject:artifact.deployedBytecode.object,links,immutables,match:true});completeBindingKeys.add(key);}
